Frontend.reason: Tracker now distinguishes a deliberately or temporarily partial cloud-sync scope from a fully unavailable account. When one independent stream is synced and the other is paused, Settings says which scope remains available instead of incorrectly showing the whole account as unavailable. Existing local data, routes, queue payloads, and sync RPC contracts remain unchanged.

Backend.reason: The coordinated Lexi backend release adds a backward-compatible migration that restores `word_record` only to enabled historical complete Tracker allowlists. It preserves schemas, RPC signatures, RLS, quotas, retention, user data, disabled configurations, and intentional partial rollouts.

Admin.reason: The coordinated Lexi Control release detects the historic enabled five-kind allowlist that lacks `word_record` and explains the correction to administrators. Existing AAL2 protection, RPC calls, user controls, data visibility, and quota controls remain unchanged.

Deployment.reason: Not deployed. Apply and verify the paired Supabase migration first, then deploy the matching Tracker client and Lexi Control commits. Production smoke tests must confirm the authenticated Settings status, word-record sync, and administrator sync page.

Verification.reason: Before release, run the Tracker release gate plus the paired Lexi full-stack release gate, test the targeted aggregation and admin/migration scenarios, verify the applied Supabase configuration, and smoke-test the authenticated production status.
